description: Use when Argo CD does not deploy or update an application in Kubernetes: an Application that is OutOfSync, Unknown, Degraded, Missing or Progressing, a ComparisonError ("app path does not exist", "unable to resolve ... to a commit SHA"), an InvalidSpecError ("do not match any of the allowed destinations in project"), a sync that fails ("one or more objects failed to apply"), auto-sync that never runs, resources that stay OutOfSync after a sync, or ApplicationSets that generate nothing. Investigates with kubectl get, describe, events and logs, and proposes fixes. Reads first and asks before changing anything.
